name: the phantown's valentine mystery
source:
'the phantown's valentine mystery' is a short, silly and funny visual novel.

Play as the ghostly detective Ins Spector and their loyal companion Dog as you try to solve the great mystery of Phantown: who is the ghost who breaks into houses and leaves mysterious note with a kiss print on it every Valentine's Day?

[From [url=https://discoreunion.itch.io/the-phantowns-valentine-mystery]Itch.io[/url]]
